title: Incorrect empty cookie handling
detail: The code returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict when a cookie string is present, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. It should return an empty dict only when no cookie string is provided.
note: Says a present cookie returns an empty dict, which the planted `if cookie:` does.

title: Incorrect file pointer check
detail: The original code skipped processing when fp was None. The new condition skips all non‑None file pointers, causing valid file data to be ignored and requests to send incomplete multipart bodies.
note: Says set file values are skipped, which the planted `is not None` does.

title: Breakpoint updates skipped when only one set is defined
detail: The condition requires both horizontal_breakpoints and vertical_breakpoints to be truthy, so if only horizontal or only vertical breakpoints are set, _set_breakpoints never runs, leaving the node without the appropriate breakpoint classes.
note: Says the update needs both kinds of breakpoint, which the planted `and` does.

title: Return type of get_module_from_module_name is too narrow
detail: The function now always returns a ModuleType, but if the import fails it should return None. The original signature allowed None, and the rest of the code expects that possibility.
